name: Keyhole
design_intent:
S3 SOCCER TRIALS #5 (proposed slot 5, trials_expansion_2026-07-19) -- the THREAD course: Needle & Key comes to the pitch. A tall bumper wall (x1440-1560) seals the goal pocket behind it; the ONLY way through is a single 180px horizontal slot (y850-1030, center 940). Ball radius 60 (diameter 120) => 30px clearance top and bottom -- a clean, well-aimed medium drive threads it; too high, too low, or too hard-off-angle smacks bumper and rebounds. Combines s3_long_ball's power with precise aim.

DERIVED SHOT (Ball._drive_from dv=(500+0.9*speed)/0.6, cap 2400, restitution 0.85; gravity 1600; boost 760): ball rests at (900,1040) on deck A (top 1100). A boost-speed drive at ~15deg (fly right, strike just under the equator) gives 1973 px/s => vx 1906, vy -511. At the wall face x1440 (dx=540), t=0.283s, ball CENTER y = 1040 - 511*0.283 + 800*0.080 = 1040 - 145 + 64 = 959 -- inside the 970-910 pass window (ball center must be 970..910 so its 60px radius stays inside the y850-1030 slot). It threads the slot and carries into the pocket, crossing the goal_zone left edge x1610 at center ~955 (inside the zone x1610-2010, y720-1080) => SCORE. The AIM WINDOW is roughly 11-18deg at full boost: too flat (~5deg, vy -172) arrives center ~1058 and smacks the LOWER wall (slot bottom 1030); too steep (~25deg, vy -834) arrives center ~872 and smacks the UPPER wall (slot top 850) -- both rebound off the bumper (restitution 0.85) back over deck A. A too-fast SUPER drive (2400) caroms off the slot lip and is self-limiting (overshoots high or rebounds), so a controlled NORMAL boost drive is the intended tool. Misses settle or fly OOB and auto-reset (2.8s), unlimited tries.

WHY A ROLLING/SLOW BALL FAILS (thread guard): the slot is LIFTED above the resting ball. A ball rolling at deck height (center 1040, spans 980-1100) meets the wall with its whole body BELOW the slot (slot bottom 1030; ball top 980 < 1030) -- it smacks the LOWER wall (x1440, y1030-1220) and stops. Only a driven ball lofted ~100px to center ~940 lines up with the slot. A super lobbed clean OVER the upper wall (clear y300) drops behind it onto the pocket CEILING (bumper x1560-2220, y620-700) and is rejected. So every non-threaded path is walled off.

NO-AUTO-SCORE GUARD: the full-height bumper wall (upper x1440,y300-850 + lower x1440,y1030-1220) is a hard barrier between the ball's rest position and the pocket; a resting ball (v=0 < BALL_LAUNCH_SPEED 220) sits on deck A and cannot self-thread. The player must supply an aimed drive.

FLIGHT-REQUIRED (player, GAME_ESSENCE): spawn (450,1000) on deck A, 450px from the ball; the player must FLY into the ball with a controlled ~flat-to-15deg boost drive (a passive bounce cannot make a boost-speed aimed contact). Deck marshmallow, wall/ceiling/back-wall bumper, void below kills; a player who follows a flubbed ball into the slot line just falls to void => free respawn. Precision, not danger -- a diff-3 read.
hint: THREAD THE BALL THROUGH THE SLOT
